items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Johnny Wilson and Barrett don't play.

ctx.x: What did the Wilsons play? Huh? What instruments did they play?
Willie Wilson was the leader. Mm-hmm. Johnny Wilson and Barrett don't play. Mm-hmm.
Shepard you said? Uh-huh. There was a fellow named Shepard? Shepard? Shepard?
